title: Arcana Splat2Mesh: local CPU 3DGS-to-mesh converter launching free
summary: ArcanaMfg announces upcoming Splat2Mesh software converting 3D Gaussian splats to mesh locally without a GPU, aiming for a mostly free tool for LichtFeld Studio and 3D-print workflows.
question_it_answers: Is there a local no-GPU tool coming to convert 3DGS splats into printable meshes?

claims.text: Arcana will release software converting 3DGS to mesh that runs locally without a GPU.
claims.evidence: ローカル環境で動作し、GPUなども不要です。
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: The Splat2Mesh tool is being prepared as basically free for anyone to use.
claims.evidence: 基本無料でどなたでもご利用いただけるように準備しています！
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: The later EN product page (200 / 73,796 B) confirms Windows 11 + OBJ/GLB + personal/non-commercial free under an EULA. Tweet “no GPU” / “basically free for anyone” stay tweet-only versus that page. Thread stays captured_partial (10/3).
claims.evidence: GET https://arcana-mfg.com/en/splat2mesh/ 200 73796 B. English page has no “GPU” / “no GPU” string.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

media.description: Demo clip attached to the Japanese Splat2Mesh announcement tweet showing splat-to-mesh conversion output.
